quote: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: At any place or in any space adjacent to a curb which has been designated and posted as a fire lane pursuant to the City's Fire Code, whether the vehicle is attended or unattended and whether the location is on public or private property.

activation.condition: Vehicle at a curb-adjacent City-designated and posted fire lane.
